title: Rav Chama, Daughter’s Son of Chasa

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 86a: Rav Kahana said, “Rav Chama, daughter’s son of Chasa, told me that Rabbah bar Nachmani died because of persecution,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The saved whole William Davidson Bava Metzia 86a scalar names Rav Kahana, Rav Chama daughter’s son of untitled Chasa, and Rabbah bar Nachmani, with the quoted persecution report. The title is supported locally; no title is transferred to Chasa and no omitted story, genealogy or chronology is admitted.
